authority: Direct human U23: do not impose an arbitrary per-response token ceiling. This supersedes the previous default token-budget proposal.
generation: For new execution protocols, use native EOS as the completion condition without an arbitrary max_new_tokens/max_length/line stop. Preserve the prescribed decoding and edit.
unavoidable_limits: Actual supported context, available memory, free compute, per-job platform wall time and the fixed research deadline remain constraints. A stop caused by one of these is recorded as resource/context interrupted, never presented as a completed wrong answer or proof of model inability. Configured context is not empirical validation of that whole context.
active_N40: Do not mutate the already-frozen active worker or discard its evidence. At terminal audit the original scope/source/outputs, preserve its original endpoint grades, and identify every non-EOS cutoff across ALL conditions. Any such reply needs a separate frozen native-own-history continuation. Exact completed replies carry; no reroll or regeneration.
continuations: Continue only unfinished responses under the exact same prompt, edit, greedy policy and native history, until native EOS or an actual resource/context interruption. Keep all conditions and cases, counters, raw tokens, checkpoint provenance and restoration guards. No new arbitrary larger token ceiling.
interpretation: If all replies reach EOS before a historical ceiling, it did not bind that panel. If any hit a ceiling, do not attribute that incompleteness to coding ability. A continuation changes the inference treatment and is reported separately; old frozen records remain intact.
